tx.field.categoryHint: Required; a rule in Settings can fill it in for you.
tx.field.propertyHint: A flat, a car, a collection…

tx.field.unitPriceHint: In the base currency at the time of buying; you can revalue it later.
debt.title: Is it a debt?
debt.hint: Debts count in “owes me / I owe” and in net worth, never as income or spending.
contacts.name: Name

contacts.removeHint: An account used by transactions is deactivated, not deleted.
contacts.empty: No contacts yet: add the people, banks and exchangers money moves with.
categories.manage.title: Categories
categories.manage.hint: The group decides where spending lands: mandatory and everyday count in the budget, bookkeeping counts nowhere. Only an unused category can be deleted; archive the rest.
categories.manage.name: Name
rules.title: Category rules
rules.hint: If the comment or the contact name contains the text, use the category. The first matching rule from the top wins; a category you chose is never replaced.
settings.savingsRateHint: Savings plan: this share of income is set aside before the daily budget.
settings.budgetCurrencyHint: Daily budget, limits and month totals are counted in it, at the rate of each operation.
settings.dailyBudgetHint: How free money is spread over the days.
stores.inBudgetHint: This wallet’s spending and income count in the daily budget and month totals.
stores.contactHint: Whose account it is: a bank, an exchange, an exchanger. Sub-accounts share it.
netWorth.title: Net worth
asset.revalueHint: The value applies to the whole history, so the net-worth chart does not jump.
onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.step.debts: Add loans and debts, if any
onboarding.step.savings: Choose what share of income to save
vault.password.title: Change password
vault.password.hint: The file is re-encrypted with the new password. A forgotten password cannot be recovered.
vault.incompatible: The file was written by an earlier version of the app and cannot be opened by this one.
errors.INCOMPATIBLE_VAULT: The file was written by an earlier version of the app and cannot be opened by this one.
tx.rate.none: no rate for this date yet — it is filled in on the next price refresh
schedule.dayHint: A shorter month uses its last day
automation.intro: Transactions that repeat by themselves: salary, rent, subscriptions. They run at 9:00.
automation.empty: No automations yet. Start with your salary — the daily budget is built on it.
automation.name: Name
automation.checkHint: Before creating a transaction the wallet balance on its date is checked. If it falls short, nothing is created and the run waits for your decision.
automation.rejected.limit: Credit limit of “{store}” exceeded: {required} needed, limit {limit}
automation.event.skipped: Runs skipped after a long break: {count}. You can retry them from the automation history.
budget.intro: Spending limits by category, wallet or in total — per day, week or month.
budget.hint: Mandatory and everyday spending of budget wallets counts, at the rate of each transaction's date.
dailyBudget.title: Daily budget
dailyBudget.noIncome: No income this month yet. Add a salary automation and the daily budget is built on it.
monthSummary.title: This month
goal.intro: Saving a set amount by a date. “Saved” is the current value; “put in” leaves out rate changes.
goal.name: Name
goal.storesHint: Wallets and sub-accounts with their children. A wallet shared by several goals is split between them.
goal.issue.commitment: Needs {need} a month, you can put aside {commitment}
goal.issue.surplus: All goals need {need} a month; usually {surplus} is left over
goalCalendar.title: Savings calendar
reminder.intro: Reminders arrive as system notifications while the app is open.

alert.title: Exchange alerts
alert.hint: Prices are checked every 5 minutes while the app is open.
upcoming.title: Coming up
settings.timezoneHint: Budget days and months and automation times follow it.

losses.internalHint: An exchange between your own sub-accounts: not spending, but the fee and spread are a loss.
losses.rowHint: Fee and the gap to the market rate at the time

flows.listHint: Money paths of several operations: what went in, what came out and what was lost on the way.
flows.empty: No chains yet. Link operations from an operation's panel.

rates.hint: In bold — currencies you use: their rate history is kept. Refresh rates with the price refresh button.
rates.noRate: No rate for one of the currencies
enrichment.consent.title: Look operations up on the blockchain?
enrichment.consent.what: The app can find a transaction's network fee and status by its hash and offer to add them to the operation.
enrichment.consent.sent: Only the transaction hash and the chosen network leave your device.
enrichment.consent.services: Requests go to public services: mempool.space (Bitcoin), the public Solana RPC and EVM explorers.
enrichment.consent.never: Amounts, wallets, contacts and the password are never sent. Nothing changes without your confirmation.
enrichment.consent.change: You can change this in Settings.
enrichment.applyHint: “Apply” adds the fee to the operation if it has none.
enrichment.event: Blockchain data found for a transaction
enrichment.settingsHint: Finds the network fee and status by hash and offers to add them to the operation.
utilities.intro: Electricity, water, internet and rent: meter readings, trend and forecast, recording a payment in one click.
utilities.name: Name
utilities.kindHint.metered: Amount = meter consumption × tariff. Enter a reading once a month.
utilities.kindHint.static: The same amount as last time; changes when you pay.
utilities.kindHint.housing: Monthly rent; the deposit is added to the first payment.
utilities.noAutomation: None — pay on the due day
utilities.automationHint: If an automation pays the rent, the payment is not counted twice in the plan.
utilities.draftFailed: Could not work out the payment
utilities.depositIncluded: The deposit is included in the first payment.
utilityBill.title: Monthly utility bill
utilityBill.readingDayHint: Empty means the month's end. Moved mid-month? Enter the move-out day for the old place and a starting reading on the move-in day for the new one: each counts from its own day and the month's bills add up.
utilityStats.title: Utilities by month
utilitiesDue.title: Utilities due

dashboard.widgetHint.utilityStats: What utilities cost month by month and how it changes
utilityHistory.title: History
utilities.dashboardHint: Forecast or last bill for each

stores.kindHint.cash: Money in your pocket. One for the whole app.

deposit.noTerms: Enter the rate to see interest earned and ahead

deposit.pds.hint: The state adds up to 36,000 ₽ a year to your contributions for 10 years from the first one; a year's money arrives by the end of August of the next year. Contributions up to 400,000 ₽ a year give a 13% tax deduction.
deposit.pds.toFull: Contribute this much more for the full 36,000 ₽

purpose.transitHint: Money passing through you: neither in the budget nor in net worth
purpose.everydayExample: Cash, salary card, credit card for purchases
purpose.transitExample: A tax reserve account, a shared family account, a friend's money

walletSettings.noAccounts: No sub-accounts yet. Add a card, a deposit or a trading account — each holds its own currency or asset.
wallet.view.title: Exchange section
wallet.importNeedsKey: Trade import works through an API key. Add one in the exchange settings.
envelope.hint: An envelope puts money aside for a purpose without moving it: it stays in the wallet but is marked as taken.
envelope.name: Name
envelope.short: The wallet holds less than is put aside. Free: {free}
envelope.noAssets: The wallet has nothing to put aside yet.
stores.deleteHint: Only an empty wallet without operations can be deleted.
automation.introWallet: Recurring operations across all wallets. New ones are created in a wallet — that is where the ready-made ones are.
utilities.noProperty: Add a property (a flat, a house) first — utilities live inside it.
utilities.dayHint: Empty means the month's end. A month can hold several readings, e.g. on the day you move.
contacts.pastePlaceholder: Paste a requisite: card, IBAN, phone, crypto address…
contacts.noHistory: No operations with this contact yet
contacts.noTurnover: No money moved with this contact yet

settingsShell.title: Settings
dashboard.catalog.title: Widget catalog
dashboard.catalog.description: Pick what to add to the dashboard. The widget takes the first free spot.
dashboard.catalog.allPlaced: Every widget is already on the dashboard.
dashboard.emptyGrid: The dashboard is empty — add widgets with «+».
dashboard.widgetHint.onboarding: First set-up steps: wallets, debts, salary.
dashboard.widgetHint.dailyBudget: How much you can spend today.
dashboard.widgetHint.monthSummary: Income, spending and savings this month.
dashboard.widgetHint.miniCalendar: The month with spending per day.
dashboard.widgetHint.budgets: Limits and how much is used.
dashboard.widgetHint.exchangeBalances: Exchange balances next to the ledger: shows what the import has not seen yet.
tour.resetHint: A tour starts by itself on the first visit of a screen. The «?» button in the header shows it any time.
tour.dashboard.grid.title: The dashboard is your grid
tour.dashboard.grid.body: Drag a widget by its header, resize it by the bottom-right corner. Gaps fill themselves. «Hide header» pins a widget.
tour.dashboard.add.title: Add a widget
tour.dashboard.add.body: The «+» button opens the catalog with a description and a live preview of each widget.
tour.dashboard.wallets.title: Wallets by kind
tour.dashboard.wallets.body: Cash is there from the start. Banks, crypto, exchanges, property and loans are added here or with «+» on their group.
tour.dashboard.settings.title: Settings
tour.dashboard.settings.body: Theme, language, currency, categories and budget — in one window with sections on the left.
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.title: Help is always near
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.body: «?» shows the tour of the current screen. Right-click any block for quick actions on it.
tour.wallet.settings.title: Wallet settings
tour.wallet.settings.body: What the money is for, sub-accounts and envelopes, automations and the exchange connection — here.
tour.wallet.views.title: Exchange sections
tour.wallet.views.body: Balance overview, a chart terminal and trade import. The terminal remembers everything in this exchange.
tour.wallet.terminal.title: Terminal
tour.wallet.terminal.body: Coins on the left; drawings and timeframe are saved in the exchange — every exchange has its own terminal.
tour.walletSettings.purpose.title: What the money is for
tour.walletSettings.purpose.body: Decides whether spending counts in the daily budget. A deposit is savings, an exchange is investment, a tax account is transit.
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.title: Envelopes
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.body: Put part of the balance aside for a purpose without moving money. An envelope can back a goal.
tour.walletSettings.presets.title: Ready-made automations
tour.walletSettings.presets.body: Templates for this kind of wallet: salary, loan payment, DCA. Only the amount and date are left to fill in.
tour.directory.create.title: New contact
tour.directory.create.body: Type a name and press Enter — the rest is filled in right in the card.
tour.directory.editor.title: A card without dialogs
tour.directory.editor.body: Click a field and edit — it saves itself. Just paste a requisite: its kind and network are detected.
tour.directory.debts.title: Debts
tour.directory.debts.body: The debt is what the operations add up to. The buttons open a transfer of the right kind; set a due date and a note below.
contacts.groupHint: E.g. «Family», «Work», «P2P». Without one the contact is listed under its kind.
tx.deleteConfirmHint: It disappears from the history and balances are recalculated. This cannot be undone.
tx.tradeOnUnified: The trade is booked on «{name}»: spot and futures live on the Unified Trading account.
storeWizard.openingHint: What is already there. Booked as one «Opening balance» operation — neither income nor spending.
storeWizard.openingInvalid: Enter a positive amount and an asset
storeWizard.bybitKeyHint: Optional: a read-only Bybit key. With it the needed sub-accounts appear right away: Unified Trading and the ones Bybit holds coins in. You can add the key later in the exchange settings too.
storeWizard.cardHint: A card is a bank account. The opening balance goes on it; more cards and accounts in this bank can be opened later with «New sub-account».
adjustment.title: Match reality
adjustment.hint: Enter what the account really holds. The difference is booked as a correction: it is neither income nor spending and stays out of budgets and reports.
adjustment.dateHint: Empty means now. A past date compares with the ledger of that moment.
adjustment.empty: Nothing on this account yet. Add an asset below if it is really there.
adjustment.addAsset: An asset the ledger does not know
adjustment.nothing: Enter the actual balance of at least one asset that differs from the ledger.
adjustment.submit: Book the correction | Book the correction ({count}) | Book the correction ({count})
tour.wallet.adjust.title: Match reality
tour.wallet.adjust.body: When the app's balance drifts from the bank or the wallet, enter the real balance: the difference is booked as a correction, not as income or spending.
storeChange.openHint: Turn a bank into a crypto wallet, move an account into another wallet of any kind, make a sub-account a wallet of its own, or merge two accounts. Operations are kept.
storeChange.title: Change kind or move: {name}
storeChange.hint: See what changes first. A .bak copy of the vault is kept before it is applied.
storeChange.nothing: Nothing to change here: the cash wallet stays what it is.
storeChange.actionHint.change_kind: Sub-accounts the new kind can hold move along (a card becomes a token account and so on). The others are split off as archived wallets of the old kind, their operations intact.
storeChange.actionHint.move_to: The account becomes a sub-account of the wallet you pick, even of another kind: its type is matched. A wallet without sub-accounts that holds one asset can be moved in too.
storeChange.actionHint.detach: The sub-account becomes a wallet of its own, of the same kind, with all its operations.
storeChange.actionHint.merge_into: Every operation of this account moves to the one you pick, and this account goes. Transfers between the two would land on one account: they show as conflicts.
storeChange.conflicts: Would not fit after the change: {count}. Fix or delete them, then try again.
storeChange.backupHint: The previous vault is kept next to it as .bak
tour.directory.groups.title: Contact groups
tour.directory.groups.body: The list is split into groups. Set one in the contact's «Group» field; without it the contact goes under its kind: people, companies, exchangers.
reminder.repeatHint: Marking it done moves it to the next date. The day is kept: the 31st becomes a short month's last day.
reminder.autoEditHint: This is an automatic reminder: after an edit its time stays yours and the sync leaves it alone.
reminder.doneRepeatHint: Done: move it to the next date
reminder.autoHint: Made from the data: a loan, rent, utilities, a deposit, a debt, a goal or a tax. It moves when the day changes and closes the month once the payment is booked.
tour.planningReminders.repeat.title: Repeating reminders
tour.planningReminders.repeat.body: Choose how often it repeats: «done» moves it to the next date, and the «More» menu snoozes it or ends the series.
simulation.title: Automations, tried out
simulation.hint: The automations run day by day on a copy of the vault, as the scheduler would run them. Nothing is written, so try anything.
simulation.nothing: The automations do nothing in this time.
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.title: Try without risk
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.body: «Try it out» runs the automations ahead on a copy of the vault: what would be created, where money would run short and what the balances would be. Nothing is written.
tour.planningReminders.filter.title: Yours and automatic
tour.planningReminders.filter.body: The app reminds you of loan, rent and utility payments, deposits ending, debts, goals and taxes by itself: those are «Auto». Edit or stop one in the «More» menu; switch whole kinds on and off in Settings → Notifications.
